_readme: Canonical product/pricing registry consumed by Netlify Functions (webhook fulfillment, entitlement grants, PDF delivery) and by the account dashboard. Edit prices, links, and PDF filenames here via /admin (Decap CMS) — no code changes needed for price updates. Each `stripe_price_id` MUST match a live Stripe Price on The Co.LLab's Stripe account, since the webhook maps incoming Stripe price IDs back to a product key by scanning this file.
_impact_readme: Impact Products designate a percentage of the purchase price to a partner nonprofit. Allocations are computed and recorded in an internal Netlify Blobs ledger at fulfillment time (netlify/functions/lib/fulfill.js) for later remittance/reconciliation. Money is NOT automatically transferred to the nonprofit via Stripe unless that partner's `stripe_connect_account_id` is set below and Stripe Connect is actually configured for that account — until then this is bookkeeping only, not a live payment split.

_partnerships_readme: The Co.LLab™ Omnidirectional Enterprise™ Partnership — a one-time PURCHASE (not an investment, no equity, no return), fully separate from the Founders Organization: no founder_rank, no Founder discount, no impact allocation, and Founders products are never included. Each tier grants, permanently, the keys in `grants` (grant_scope 'designated') or every non-Founders product, Blueprint™ issue and bonus product (grant_scope 'complete'), plus Membership, Library Card, and Journal for term_months from purchase (a tier with "lifetime": true never expires) with no subscription (netlify/functions/lib/fulfill.js). Tiers with includes_eligible_releases also keep any product later added here with "partnership_release": true and a "released_at" date inside their term. `seats` counts the purchaser; extra seats are claimed through single-use invite links (netlify/functions/partnership-seats.js). After the term, memberships renew at regular prices. All sales final once access is unlocked, subject to applicable law. The standard Co.LLab IP license applies at every tier. Tiers with releases_months keep eligible releases only within that many months of purchase.
